name: Etheridge Lakes Data Center
summary: Chesapeake City Council unanimously denied the Etheridge Lakes rezoning after extensive public comment and an earlier Planning Commission recommendation against it.
proposal_description: The applicant sought to rezone a 22.6-acre parcel near Centerville Turnpike and Etheridge Manor Boulevard for a two-story data center.
site_afterlife: No verified replacement development on the parcel is published here. Chesapeake subsequently developed broader data-center policy, a distinct citywide outcome that should not be confused with parcel reuse.
evidence_note: The denial is final for the reviewed rezoning. Community testimony is well documented, but the record also cites land-use compatibility and availability of other viable uses.
unresolved_questions: What is the current ownership and entitlement status of the Etheridge Lakes parcel?
Did the applicant pursue a permitted alternative use after denial?
Were utility-capacity reservations or interconnection requests released?
How many future applications were altered or deterred by Chesapeake's 2026 ordinance?

timeline.title: Rezoning application begins review
timeline.summary: The city opened review of a proposal for a data center adjacent to established residential and agricultural uses.

timeline.title: Council refers the application through public review
timeline.summary: Official work-session and meeting records place the rezoning into the city's hearing process.

timeline.title: Planning Commission recommends denial
timeline.summary: The commission recommended denial after extensive written opposition and testimony about compatibility, noise, traffic, power, and nearby homes.

timeline.title: City Council unanimously denies rezoning
timeline.summary: Council first declined the applicant's requested continuance and then denied the rezoning 7–0.

timeline.title: Residents press their case at the council hearing
timeline.summary: The public record documents substantial opposition while staff recommended approval and the Planning Commission recommended denial.

timeline.title: Council initiates citywide data-center rules
timeline.summary: Council adopted an initiating resolution for ordinance and policy changes governing future data-center siting.

timeline.title: Council pauses new applications during policy work
timeline.summary: The city imposed an eight-month application pause as it completed revised zoning controls.

timeline.title: City adopts a broader data-center ordinance
timeline.summary: The city later adopted an ordinance governing future data-center siting. This is tracked as a policy consequence, not an economic effect of the rejected parcel.

county_outcome_context.note: The city-county panel ends in 2024, before the June 2025 denial, leaving zero full post-decision years. Chesapeake's later citywide ordinance is an institutional outcome, but it cannot yet be translated into a measured economic effect.
